```bash
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# R3-only matched checkpoints (8 points where both seeds have data)
steps = [1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 5500, 6000, 6500]
seed1 = [0.074, 0.085, 0.095, 0.114, 0.114, 0.114, 0.085, 0.153]
seed2 = [0.084, 0.085, 0.095, 0.143, 0.104, 0.114, 0.095, 0.105]

r, p = stats.pearsonr(seed1, seed2)
print(f'Pearson r = {r:.4f}')
print(f'p-value = {p:.4f}')
print(f'n = {len(steps)}')
print(f'95% CI: bootstrapping...')

# Bootstrap 95% CI for r
np.random.seed(42)
n_bootstrap = 10000
rs = []
for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
    idx = np.random.choice(len(seed1), size=len(seed1), replace=True)
    s1 = [seed1[i] for i in idx]
    s2 = [seed2[i] for i in idx]
    if np.std(s1) > 0 and np.std(s2) > 0:
        r_boot, _ = stats.pearsonr(s1, s2)
        rs.append(r_boot)
rs = sorted(rs)
ci_low = rs[int(0.025 * len(rs))]
ci_high = rs[int(0.975 * len(rs))]
print(f'Bootstrap 95% CI: [{ci_low:.4f}, {ci_high:.4f}]')

# Also compute Spearman (rank correlation, more robust to outliers)
rho, p_spearman = stats.spearmanr(seed1, seed2)
print(f'Spearman rho = {rho:.4f}, p = {p_spearman:.4f}')

# Summary
print()
print('=== Summary ===')
print(f'Pearson r={r:.3f} (p={p:.3f}), Spearman rho={rho:.3f} (p={p_spearman:.3f})')
print(f'Bootstrap 95% CI for r: [{ci_low:.3f}, {ci_high:.3f}]')
print(f'Interpretation: {\"low\" if abs(r) < 0.3 else \"moderate\" if abs(r) < 0.6 else \"high\"} correlation')
"
```
